```{python}
#| include: false
# Data: small aggregated dbt models (decision 034), read-only from the DuckDB warehouse.
import duckdb
import folium
import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px
from branca.colormap import linear

from madrid_air_quality_pipeline.config import WAREHOUSE_PATH

with duckdb.connect(str(WAREHOUSE_PATH), read_only=True) as con:
    daily = con.execute("select * from agg_daily_station_pollutant").df()
    stations = con.execute("select * from agg_station_summary").df()
    profile = con.execute("select * from agg_hourly_profile").df()
    bins = con.execute("select * from agg_weather_bins").df()

# DuckDB DATE columns may arrive as Python dates; make them pandas datetimes.
daily["date_local"] = pd.to_datetime(daily["date_local"])
profile["day_type"] = profile["day_type"].map({"weekday": "Monday–Friday", "weekend": "Weekend"})

POLLUTANT_ORDER = {"pollutant_symbol": ["NO2", "O3", "PM10", "PM2.5"]}
UNIT = "µg/m³"
TEMPLATE = "plotly_white"


def style(fig):
    """Shared layout: horizontal legend above the plot, white template, tight margins.

    Legend entries get a fixed width: Plotly measures legend text on screen, and inside
    dashboard cards that measurement can come out near zero, making entries overlap.
    """
    return fig.update_layout(
        template=TEMPLATE,
        legend=dict(
            orientation="h", yanchor="bottom", y=1.04, xanchor="left", x=0,
            title_text="", entrywidth=110, entrywidthmode="pixels",
        ),
        margin=dict(l=10, r=10, t=60, b=10),
    )


def station_map(data):
    """Leaflet map with one circle per station, coloured and sized by mean concentration.

    Built inside a function so that only the finished map is displayed: Quarto shows the
    result of every expression in a cell, including each marker added in a loop.
    """
    colormap = linear.OrRd_09.scale(data["avg_value"].min(), data["avg_value"].max())
    colormap.caption = f"Mean NO₂ ({UNIT})"
    fmap = folium.Map(location=[40.42, -3.70], zoom_start=11, tiles="OpenStreetMap")
    for station in data.itertuples():
        folium.CircleMarker(
            location=[station.latitude, station.longitude],
            radius=6 + station.avg_value / 4,
            color=colormap(station.avg_value),
            fill=True,
            fill_opacity=0.85,
            tooltip=f"{station.station_name}: {station.avg_value:.1f} {UNIT}",
        ).add_to(fmap)
    colormap.add_to(fmap)
    return fmap


def weather_chart(variable: str, x_title: str):
    """Mean concentration by bin of one weather variable, one line per pollutant."""
    data = bins[bins["weather_variable"] == variable].sort_values("bin_lower")
    fig = px.line(
        data,
        x="bin_lower",
        y="avg_value",
        color="pollutant_symbol",
        markers=True,
        category_orders=POLLUTANT_ORDER,
        hover_data={"valid_hours": ":,"},
        labels={"bin_lower": x_title, "avg_value": f"Mean concentration ({UNIT})",
                "pollutant_symbol": "Pollutant", "valid_hours": "Hours"},
    )
    return style(fig)
```

```{python}
#| title: "Monthly mean concentration, all stations"
monthly = (
    daily.assign(month=daily["date_local"].dt.to_period("M").dt.to_timestamp())
    .groupby(["month", "pollutant_symbol"], as_index=False)["avg_value"]
    .mean()
)
style(px.line(
    monthly,
    x="month",
    y="avg_value",
    color="pollutant_symbol",
    category_orders=POLLUTANT_ORDER,
    labels={"month": "", "avg_value": f"Mean ({UNIT})", "pollutant_symbol": "Pollutant"},
))
```

```{python}
#| title: "Rain washes out particles"
rain = bins[bins["weather_variable"] == "precipitation_mm"].copy()
rain["bin"] = rain["bin_lower"].map({0.0: "Dry", 0.1: "< 1 mm", 1.0: "1–5 mm", 5.0: "≥ 5 mm"})
style(px.bar(
    rain.sort_values("bin_lower"),
    x="bin",
    y="avg_value",
    color="pollutant_symbol",
    barmode="group",
    category_orders=POLLUTANT_ORDER,
    labels={"bin": "Hourly precipitation", "avg_value": f"Mean ({UNIT})",
            "pollutant_symbol": "Pollutant"},
))
```

## Row

```{python}
#| title: "Share of hours with a valid measurement"
coverage = stations.pivot_table(
    index="station_name", columns="pollutant_symbol", values="valid_share"
).reindex(columns=POLLUTANT_ORDER["pollutant_symbol"])
fig = px.imshow(
    coverage,
    color_continuous_scale="Greens",
    zmin=0,
    zmax=1,
    text_auto=".0%",
    aspect="auto",
    labels={"x": "Pollutant", "y": "", "color": "Valid hours"},
).update_layout(template=TEMPLATE, margin=dict(l=10, r=10, t=10, b=10)).update_yaxes(dtick=1)
fig
```

```{python}
#| title: "Coverage and validation flags by station"
table = stations[[
    "station_name", "pollutant_symbol", "first_date", "last_date",
    "valid_hours", "flag_n_hours", "flag_other_hours", "valid_share",
]].sort_values(["station_name", "pollutant_symbol"])
for column in ["first_date", "last_date"]:
    table[column] = pd.to_datetime(table[column]).dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
table.rename(columns={
    "station_name": "Station", "pollutant_symbol": "Pollutant", "first_date": "From",
    "last_date": "To", "valid_hours": "Valid hours", "flag_n_hours": "Flag N",
    "flag_other_hours": "Other flags", "valid_share": "Valid %",
}).style.hide(axis="index").format({"Valid %": "{:.1%}", "Valid hours": "{:,}"})
```

# About

::: {.card title="About this dashboard"}
**Question:** how does weather affect air pollution in Madrid?

Hourly air quality from the 24 monitoring stations of Madrid City Council, joined with hourly
weather from the Open-Meteo archive for each station. Built by an ELT pipeline in Python, dbt and
DuckDB, orchestrated with Airflow; this page is regenerated every week by GitHub Actions.

**Reading the charts.** Values are hourly means of validated measurements (flag `V`) in µg/m³.
Weather charts group hours by weather conditions; they show associations, not causes: wind,
temperature and the mixing layer also follow the time of day and the season.

**Sources:** [datos.madrid.es](https://datos.madrid.es/) ·
[Open-Meteo](https://open-meteo.com/en/docs/historical-weather-api)

**Code, tests and the 34 design decisions:**
[github.com/danielazo2002/madrid-air-quality-pipeline](https://github.com/danielazo2002/madrid-air-quality-pipeline)
:::
